title: Vox Amelior
summary: A local-first, privacy-focused AI voice platform with real-time speech recognition, LLM inference, and 22 specialized ML prediction engines running as containerized microservices. Its 'Mirror' engine imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata (plus sdmetrics' QualityReport) to generate and evaluate synthetic tabular data for comparative analysis, so SDV's CTGAN synthesizer is run directly as one of many predictive engines.
evidence: services/ml-service/src/engines/mirror_engine.py:47-48: 'from sdv.metadata import SingleTableMetadata' / 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer'
needs: Unclear exactly how CTGAN output is used downstream (comparison metric vs augmentation) within the Mirror engine's business logic.
